title: How Multi-Timescale Memory Cools Optimization: Theory and Evidence from AdEMAMix
abstract: arXiv:2611.29588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Augmenting AdamW with multiple momentum timescales improves large language model pretraining, yet the mechanism driving these gains remains poorly understood. We identify an interaction between multi-timescale optimizer memory and the geometry of normalized networks: memory changes parameter norms and thereby controls how fast parameters rotate. Starting from exact norm dynamics under decoupled weight decay, we show that the parameter norm depends on the temporal correlation of the updates, with weight decay controlling how long these correlations influence optimization. We show how an independently weighted slow momentum can substantially increase the norm of parameters, while contributing negligible power to the instantaneous update, therefore acting as an endogenous annealing schedule. translated_title: 多时间尺度记忆如何“冷却”优化：来自AdEMAMix的理论与证据
translated_abstract: 在AdamW中加入多个动量时间尺度可以改进大语言模型的预训练，但驱动这些收益的机制仍知之甚少。我们识别出多时间尺度优化器记忆与归一化网络几何结构之间的相互作用：记忆会改变参数范数，从而控制参数旋转的快慢。从解耦权重衰减下的精确范数动力学出发，我们证明参数范数取决于更新的时间相关性，而权重衰减控制这些相关性影响优化的时间长度。我们展示了独立加权的慢速动量如何能显著增大参数范数，同时对瞬时更新的贡献微乎其微，因此充当了一种内生的退火调度。我们在AdEMAMix的语言模型预训练中研究了这一机制。受控干预实验表明，这种调度机制具有明确的实际意义。
tldr: 该论文揭示多时间尺度优化器记忆通过改变参数范数来控制参数旋转速度，证明AdEMAMix中独立加权的慢速动量本质上充当一种内生的退火调度，从而解释了其在语言模型预训练中带来收益的机制。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that multi-timescale optimizer memory controls the speed of parameter rotation by changing parameter norms, showing that AdEMAMix's independently weighted slow momentum acts as an endogenous annealing schedule, which explains its gains in language model pretraining.
